assignment_rationale: Each experiment uses one model family across dimensions; each dataset has its own fitted model and coalition value function. Table 6 measures generation of Table 1's XGBoost games, and the California case reuses Table 1's d=8 game. Table 2 uses LightGBM on German Credit, Table 3 uses a decision tree on Adult, and Tables 4 and 5 share the Adult MLP game, with Table 5 evaluating stability over ten estimator seeds. Nine distinct (dataset, model) games cover the paper experiments.
